title: Scheduled Queue
description: Prevents scheduled sends going out wrong or unnoticed: each row counts down live, the last-chance window highlights and counts down to the real cancel cutoff (when the provider locks the send in), sends landing in quiet hours where the audience lives get a one-tap move to a sane hour, missed sends are flagged, and rescheduling refuses a time in the past.
mistakes: scheduled send went out wrong time
